hook.sub: 5 mobility moves. One dumbbell. No mat required.

items.title: Cat-cow
items.line: Hands and knees. Round your back up, then let it sag.

items.title: World's greatest stretch
items.line: Big lunge, hand inside your foot, reach to the ceiling.
items.tip: The name is not an exaggeration.

items.title: Goblet squat hold
items.line: Dumbbell at your chest. Sit deep and hang out.
items.tip: Only as deep as feels okay.

items.title: Open book
items.line: On your side. Open your top arm like turning a page.

items.title: Hip flexor stretch
items.line: One knee down. Squeeze that glute, shift forward.
items.tip: Pad the knee with a couch cushion.
